title: FloodGuard Building Rates for Newly Mapped and Zone VE Buildings
content:
Rate manual page — building rate at renewal offer, FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.

The building rate applied to a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy at its renewal offer is selected from the flood zone on file and, for a building in zone A or AE, the map revision date on file, both read on the renewal offer date.

## Rate rule

A building in zone A or AE whose map revision date on file is fewer than 24 months before the renewal offer date is rated at the newly mapped rate of 1.45; a building in zone VE is rated at the zone VE building rate of 6.42 raised by the tier's zone VE surcharge percentage; every other building is rated at the zone building rate of its flood zone on file.

## Rate schedule

| Building on the renewal offer date | Building rate |
|---|---|
| Zone A or AE, map revision date on file fewer than 24 months before the renewal offer date | 1.45 (newly mapped rate) |
| Zone VE, whatever its map revision date | 6.42 raised by the tier's zone VE surcharge percentage |
| Zone X | Zone building rate of zone X on file |
| Zone A or AE with no map revision date on file, or one 24 months or more before the renewal offer date | Zone building rate of its zone on file |

## Boundary notes (hypothetical dates)

- Renewal offer date 1 May of a given year; map revision date on file 2 May two years earlier, which is 23 whole months before: fewer than 24 months, so a zone AE building is rated at 1.45.
- Same renewal offer date; map revision date 1 May two years earlier, exactly 24 months before: not fewer than 24 months, so the building is rated at the zone building rate of its zone on file.
- A zone VE building whose map was revised three months before the renewal offer date is rated at the zone VE rate raised by the surcharge; the newly mapped rate is reserved to zones A and AE.

## Raising the zone VE rate (hypothetical)

With a hypothetical tier zone VE surcharge percentage of 20, the rate is 6.42 raised by 20 percent, that is 6.42 multiplied by 1.20, which is 7.704. With a hypothetical surcharge percentage of 0, the rate stays 6.42.
